title: Use a workflow of Idea or reference image → Custom GPT → Image 2.0 storyboard →…
content: Use a workflow of Idea or reference image → Custom GPT → Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 → final video to turn a concept into a structured cinematic storyboard before generating in Seedance 2.5
tips: Use a workflow of Idea or reference image → Custom GPT → Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 → final video to turn a concept into a structured cinematic storyboard before generating in Seedance 2.5

es.content: Usa un flujo de trabajo de Idea o imagen de referencia → Custom GPT → Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 → video final para convertir un concepto en un storyboard cinematográfico estructurado antes de generar en Seedance 2.5

fr.content: Utilisez un workflow allant de l’idée ou de l’image de référence → Custom GPT → storyboard Image 2.0 → Seedance 2.5 → vidéo finale pour transformer un concept en storyboard cinématographique structuré avant la génération dans Seedance 2.5

ja.content: アイデアまたは参考画像 → Custom GPT → Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 → final video というワークフローを使って、コンセプトを構造化された cinematic storyboard に落とし込み、その後 Seedance 2.5 で生成します。

ko.content: 아이디어 또는 참고 이미지 → Custom GPT → Image 2.0 스토리보드 → Seedance 2.5 → 최종 영상의 워크플로를 사용해, Seedance 2.5에서 생성하기 전에 콘셉트를 구조화된 cinematic storyboard로 전환하세요.

pt.content: Use um fluxo de trabalho de Ideia ou imagem de referência → Custom GPT → storyboard do Image 2.0 → Seedance 2.5 → vídeo final para transformar um conceito em um storyboard cinematográfico estruturado antes de gerar no Seedance 2.5

zh.content: 使用“创意或参考图像 → 自定义 GPT → Image 2.0 分镜脚本 → Seedance 2.5 → 最终视频”的工作流程，在 Seedance 2.5 中生成之前，先将一个概念转化为结构化的 cinematic storyboard。
